subject: Start an app from within an app

messages.author: 18dfb1393eda7b0e
messages.subject: Start an app from within an app
parts:
I have a running shiny application. What I want to do is add an actionButton that will launch an separate shiny application in a new tab.  My question is how to best code this situation.

My ideas so far involve two invocation logics depending on the context the first application is running in:

Localhost context: I would have a system command that starts RScript and runs a script that includes runApp(launch.browser = TRUE).  This seems to work. 

Client/server context: I could use browseURL().

Are there better approaches?

Cheers, Nick
